algorithm.background: Median profile from peak+30 to cylinder_top-30
algorithm.common_shape: Maximum detected width and height over acquisition; extend right/top only

roi.spot_measurement_definition: Observation-only high-pass bright round candidates in six preset views; FWHM of connected peak; not calibrated bead diameters or GT landmarks

experiment_sequence: Preplanned full31 versus crop31/15/9; crop21 added after inspecting final crop31/15 geometry to explore the intermediate window. No ROI/checkpoint adjustment.

controlled_conditions.initialization: Original MotionNetHash_9DoF initialization; no layer reset; circular nominal input P

loss_config.name: signed_lncc
loss_config.smooth_dr_units: Floor for each weighted variance sum, not variance mean or variance product

regularization.input: Applied bounded nominal-relative motion9 = bounds * tanh(raw9); not raw9 or network weights
regularization.normalization: Mean squared (parameter / physical group scale) over views and three coordinates; scales may be set to training bounds
regularization.target: Zero nominal correction, not GT geometry or an estimated source position
regularization.limitation: A training prior that can bias geometry; not exact gauge removal or a guarantee of accurate P

controlled_conditions.model: Existing MotionNetHash_9DoF; all nine parameters free; no sine trajectory prior

limitations: One GT realization, noise seed and optimization seed; fixed epoch 100, not proof of full convergence.
No crop parameters or checkpoints selected using GT; all beads and full images remain in evaluation.
Different cropped/window image-loss values are not comparable; use common full-image metrics and geometry.
Crop affects the loss only; full-detector Joseph projection is still computed.
The original LNCC zero padding is retained at crop edges. 31-pixel windows touch the boundary near some beads.
Rectangle excludes the bright bottom plate band but is not a material segmentation.
The crop jointly removes surrounding air and the bottom plate; their separate effects are not isolated.
Two identical-model A6000 GPUs were used; initial model, motion and P are byte-verified. GPU timing is indicative.
